result.title: Comparing Each Generation with Independent Siblings Gives Video World Model Post-Training a Proper Objective for Outcome Frequencies
result.summary: Video world models are used as simulators, so when a first frame leaves several physical outcomes open, repeated generations should produce each outcome as often as it occurs in the data. Physics post-training scores every generation against the single recorded future of its history, which makes single videos more faithful, but the expected score is linear in the model distribution and is maximized by always producing the most likely outcome. The log-likelihood of the recorded outcome is maximized by the data distribution, and its gradient weights agreement with the record by the inverse of how often the model produces the generated outcome, a frequency that other generations of the same history with independent noise, its siblings, can estimate. To train with this weight from a finite group, we propose SibPO, which performs Sibling-paired Policy Optimization: siblings estimate a truncated inverse-frequency weight for agreement with the record, and a second term subtracts the same weight times the agreement with the siblings, which makes the expected objective a strictly proper divergence over outcome cells at every group size. On PisaBench, SibPO lowers the KS distance to simulated landing times by 9.1-10.2% relative to the strongest method outside its reward family on three of four video models without degrading single videos, and it lowers the error of estimated robot policy success rates by 13%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对视频世界模型的物理后训练，指出对单一记录未来打分会使期望分数随模型分布线性变化、被最可能结果占优，提出 SibPO：用同史独立噪声的兄弟样本估计截断逆频率权重，使目标在每个组规模下都成为对结果格的严格 proper 散度，并在 PisaBench 上降低着陆时间 KS 距离与策略成功率估计误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单条记录监督导致分布坍缩」的诊断与兄弟样本逆频率加权，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 轨迹或假设采样的贡献分配与训练目标提供可核查线索，但需先判断该机制能否迁移到推理状态监督。
